dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned rings with jagged, high-contrast perimeters are visible. These structures show a distinct gradient from dark interior centers to bright, high-intensity outer edges, particularly concentrated in the upper-mid dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity light spots lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated on the lower lateral flanks and toward the base of the hind appendages.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form an irregular scalene quadrilateral. A smaller, nearly equilateral triangular relationship is formed by a cluster of three rings on the upper right dorsal-lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A highly prominent, dark linear feature is visible on the upper dorsal/neck region, characterized by a series of parallel, vertical ridges resembling a stitched pattern. Several smaller, dark circular punctate lesions are visible on the lateral mid-body.
other_distinctive_markers: The parallel-ridge morphology of the upper dorsal scar provides a unique topographical identifier not present elsewhere on the visible epidermis.
